method: Eight shortcut-routing probes. candidates(before:) body copied directly from current production source. Application ordering modeled from refreshShortcut/applyShortcut/closeComposition/deleteTrailing using real InputCoordinator + FakeDocument. No device UI validation; no production fixes.

evidence: iyi  ki doğdun offers the same shortcut but applying does nothing
iyi\nki doğdun offers the same shortcut but applying does nothing
findings.cause: candidates splits whitespace and rejoins words with one space, returning a normalized trigger. deleteTrailing requires the original document suffix to equal that normalized trigger.
findings.status: reproduced in routing model; UI confirmation pending

evidence: Document trXYZ with only XYZ selected produces shortcut for before-selection tr; modeled application yields t🇹🇷
Same probe with prefix önce yields önce t🇹🇷
findings.cause: refreshShortcut uses before-selection context without excluding active selection. closeComposition clears coordinator selection state but not host selection. First deleteBackward removes selection; remaining fixed-count deletes consume only part of trigger.
findings.limitation: Selection ends at document end in the fixture, so FakeDocument cursor semantics are faithful for this trace. Recorder rollover and UIKit callback timing not exercised; keep pending real UI verification.
findings.status: reproduced in routing model; UI confirmation pending
